verdict.rationale: Smooth supports multi-step sequential task execution within a persistent browser session (docs-7, docs-14, docs-34) and a task-list/cancel API (docs-37, docs-38), which lets a workflow process several items one after another, but there is no documented bulk/batch endpoint, parallel execution, or 'run against N items' primitive.  missing for 10: explicit batch/bulk API or parallel multi-item execution, evidence of throughput at scale, independent confirmation of bulk workflows.
